I have 2 different routines; let’s cover the second option if your primary desire is improving the appearance & health of the skin, make sure to watch part 1 if your primary desire is regarding the texture & tone of the skin! 🤭  1 | a bha or salicylic acid on to the area as needed; whether that may be the entire leg or certain sections 2 | after allowing your salicylic acid to fully absorb & dry into the skin, follow with water to redampen the skin & prepare for further moisturizers 3 | layer an UNFRAGRANCED hydrating body serum containing ingredients like hyaluronic acid, saltair’s serum is my go to for this 4 | allow your primer to absorb, but then follow with a primary moisturizer; being an UNFRAGRANCED body butter, Aquaphor’s body cream will serve great for this 5 | add an UNFRAGRANCED body balm or occlusive to the areas of your skin that are thicker & harsher (the knees) I love Palmer’s body bal, for this, but Aquaphor will also serve well 6 | *optional* seal everything with an UNFRAGRANCED body oil of your choice #jemaialzonia #bodycare #legcare #legs #bodycareroutine featuring; @The Ordinary Salicylic Acid Body Serum 🧪 @Saltair Body HA Body Serum 💧  @AquaphorUS Body Cream 💙 @Palmer's Body Balm + Body oil 🥥
